verses.sanskrit: युधिष्ठिर उवाच। मया गवां पुरीषं वै श्रिया जुष्टमिति श्रुतम् । एतदिच्छाम्यहं श्रोतुं संशयोऽत्र पितामह ॥१॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said I have heard that the dung of the cow is gifted with prosperity. I wish to hear how this has been occasioned. I have doubts, O grand father which you should remove.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्म उवाच। अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । गोभिर्नृपेह संवादं श्रिया भरतसत्तम ॥२॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Regarding it is cited the old story, O king of the conversation between kine and godless of prosperity, O best of the Bharatas.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीः कृत्वेह वपुः कान्तं गोमध्येषु विवेश ह । गावोऽथ विस्मितास्तस्या दृष्ट्वा रूपस्य संपदम् ॥३॥
verses.english: Once on a time, assuming a very beautiful form, the goddess Shree entered a herd of kine. Sceing her beauty the kine became filled with wonder.

verses.sanskrit: गाव ऊचुः । काऽसि देवि कुतो वा त्वं रूपेणाप्रतिमा भुवि । विस्मिताः स्म महाभागे तव रूपस्य सम्पदा ॥४॥
verses.english: The kine said Who are you, O goddess? Whence have you become nonpareil on Earth for beauty? O highly blessed goddess, we have been filled with wonder at your beauty.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छाम त्वां वयं ज्ञातुं का त्वं क्व च गमिष्यसि । तत्त्वेन वरवर्णा मे सर्वमेतद्ब्रवीहि नः ॥५॥
verses.english: We wish to know who you are. Who indeed, are you? Where will you proceed? O vou of very great beauty, do tell us in detail all We wish to know!

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुवाच । लोककान्तास्मि भद्रं वः श्रीर्नामाऽहं परिश्रुता । मया दैत्याः परित्यक्ता विनष्टाः शाश्वतीः समाः ॥६॥
verses.english: Shree said Blessed be you, I am dear to all creatures. Indeed. I am known by the name of Shree. Forsaken by me, the demons have been lost for ever.

verses.sanskrit: मयाऽभिपन्ना देवाश्च मोदन्ते शाश्वतीः समाः । इन्द्रो विवस्वान्सोमश्च विष्णुरापोऽग्निरेव च ॥७॥
verses.english: The celestials, viz., Indra, Vivasvat, Soma, Vishnu, Varuna, and Agni, having obtained me, are sporting happily and will do so for ever.

verses.sanskrit: मयाभिपन्नाः सिध्यन्ते ऋषयो देवतास्तथा । यान्नाविशाम्यहं गावस्ते विनश्यन्ति सर्वशः ॥८॥
verses.english: Indeed, the Rishis and the celestials, only when they are endued with me, become successful. You kine, those beings meet with destruction into whom I do not enter.

verses.sanskrit: धर्मश्चार्थश्च कामश्च मया जुष्टाः सुखान्विताः । एवंप्रभावां मां गावो विजानीत सुखप्रदाः ॥९॥
verses.english: Virtue, Prosperity, and Pleasure, only when endued with me, become sources of happiness. You kine, who are givers of sources of happiness, know that I am gifted with such energy.

verses.sanskrit: इच्छामि चापि युष्मासु वस्तुं सर्वासु नित्यदा । आगत्य प्रार्थये युष्माञ्छ्रीजुष्टा भवताऽथ वै ॥१०॥
verses.english: I wish to always live in every one of you. Going to your presence, I solicit you. Be all of you gifted with Shree.

verses.sanskrit: गाव ऊचुः । अध्रुवा चपला च त्वं सामान्या बहुभिः सह । न त्वामिच्छाम भद्रं ते गम्यतां यत्र रंस्यसे ॥११॥
verses.english: The kine said You are fickle and restless. You allow yourself to be enjoyed by many persons. We do not wish to have you! Blessed be you, go wherever you like.

verses.sanskrit: वपुष्मन्त्यो वयं सर्वाः किमस्माकं त्वयाद्य वै । यथेष्टं गम्यतां तत्र कृतकार्या वयं त्वया ॥१२॥
verses.english: As regards ourselves, all of us have good forms. What need have we with you? Go wherever you like. You have already pleased us greatly.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुवाच । किमेतद्वः क्षमं गावो यन्मां नेहाभिनन्दथ । न मां संप्रति गृह्णीध्वं कस्माद्वै दुर्लभां सतीम् ॥१३॥
verses.english: Shree said Is it proper with you, you kine, that you do not welcome me? I am difficult of being attained. Why then do you not accept me?

verses.sanskrit: सत्यं च लोकवादोऽयं लोके चरति सुव्रताः । स्वयं प्राप्ते परिभवो भवतीति विनिश्चयः ॥१४॥
verses.english: It appears, you creatures of excellent vows, that the popular proverb is true, viz., that it is certain that when one comes to another of this own accord and without being sought, he is not much respected.

verses.sanskrit: महदुग्रं तपः कृत्वा मां निषेवन्ति मानवाः । देवदानवगन्धर्वाः पिशाचोरगराक्षसाः ॥१५॥
verses.english: The gods, the Danavas, the Gandharvas, the Pishachas, the Uragas, the Rakshasas, and human being succeed in getting me only after practising the severest austerities.

verses.sanskrit: प्रभाव एष वो गावः प्रतिगृह्णीत मामिह । नावमन्या ह्यहं सौम्यास्त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ॥१६॥
verses.english: You who have such energy, do you take me! You amiable ones, I am never dishonoured by any one in the three worlds of mobile and immobile creatures.

verses.sanskrit: गाव ऊचुः । नावमन्यामहे देवि न त्वां परिभवामहे । अध्रुवा चलचित्ताऽसि ततस्त्वां वर्जयामहे ॥१७॥
verses.english: The kine said We do not disregard you, O goddess! We do not slight you! You are fickle and of a very restless heart. It is for this only that we take leave of you.

verses.sanskrit: बहुना च किमुक्तेन गम्यतां यत्र वांच्छसि । वपुष्मन्त्यो वयं सर्वाः किमस्माकं त्वयाऽनघे ॥१८॥
श्रीरुवाच । अवज्ञाता भविष्यामि सर्वलोकस्य मानदाः । प्रत्याख्यानेन युष्माकं प्रसादः क्रियतां मम ॥१९॥
verses.english: Shree said You givers of honours, renounced by you thus, I shall certainly be an object of disregard with all the world? Do you show me grace.

verses.sanskrit: महाभागा भवत्यो वै शरण्याः शरणागताम् । परित्रायन्तु मां नित्यं भजमानामनिन्दिताम् ॥२०॥
verses.english: You are all highly blessed, You are ever ready to grant protection to those who seek your protection. I have come to you soliciting your refuge. I have no fault. Do you rescue me.

verses.sanskrit: माननामहमिच्छामि भवत्यः सततं शिवाः । अप्येकाङ्गेष्वधो वस्तुमिच्छामि च सुकुत्सिते ॥२१॥
verses.english: Know that I shall always be devoted to you! I wish to live in any part of your bodies, however repulsive it may be. Indeed, I wish to live even in you rectum.

verses.sanskrit: न वोऽस्ति कुत्सितं किञ्चिदङ्गेष्वालक्ष्यतेनघाः । पुण्याः पवित्राः सुभगा ममादेशं प्रयच्छथ ॥२२॥
verses.english: You sinless ones, I do not see that you have any part in your bodies that may be considered as repulsive, for you are sacred, and purifying, and highly blessed! Do you, however, grant my prayer. Do you tell me in which part of your bodies shall I live.

verses.sanskrit: वसेयं यत्र वो देहे तन्मे व्याख्यातुमर्हथ । एवमुक्तास्ततो गावः शुभाः करुणवत्सलाः । संमन्त्र्य सहिताः सर्वाः श्रियमूचुर्नराधिप ॥२३॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Thus addressed by Shree, the kine, always auspicious and bent on showing kindness to all who are devoted to them, parleyed with one another, and then addressing Shree, said to her, O king, these words.

verses.sanskrit: अवश्यं मानना कार्या तवास्माभिर्यशस्विनि । शकृन्मूत्रे निवस त्वं पुण्यमेतद्धि नः शुभे  ॥२४॥
verses.english: The kine said you of great fame, it is certainly desirable that we should honour you! Do you live in our urine and dung. Both these are sacred, O goddess.

verses.sanskrit: श्रीरुवाच । दिष्ट्या प्रसादो युष्माभिः कृतो मेऽनुग्रहात्मकः । एवं भवतु भद्रं वः पूजितास्मि सुखप्रदाः ॥२५॥
verses.english: Shree said By good luck, you have shown me much favour. Let it be even as you say! Blessed by you all, I have really been honoured by you, you givers of happiness.

verses.sanskrit: एवं कृत्वा तु समयं श्रीर्गोभिः सह भारत । पश्यन्तीनां ततस्तासां तत्रैवान्तरधीयत ॥२६॥
verses.english: Bhishma said Having, O Bharata, made this contract with kine, Shree there and then, before those kine, disappeared.

verses.sanskrit: एवं गोशकृतः पुत्र माहात्म्यं तेऽनुवर्णितम् । माहात्म्यं च गवां भूयः श्रूयतां गदतो मम ॥२७॥
verses.english: I have thus told you, O son, the glory of the dung of kine. I shall once again describe to you the glory of kine. Do you listen to me.
